messages:
Sahil: Quick sync — planning to flip feature flag `new-routing-v2` to 10% (canary). Staging shows +0.03 recall on our eval set but p95 latency up ~30ms. Need concrete guardrails and stop conditions before I toggle in prod. Plan I have: 5% -> 10% -> 25% over 48h. Thoughts?

Amanda: Product is okay with a conservative canary. We need a clear rollback rule and a guardrail that preserves user-facing quality. Also exclude enterprise customers from canary.

Maria: Metrics proposal:
- primary: normalized quality score on eval (delta vs baseline)
- secondary: p95 latency, error rate (5xx), RU cost per 1k tokens
Stop rule (suggested):
- auto-rollback if quality delta <= -0.5% sustained for 30m OR
- p95 latency increases by >=50ms relative baseline for 15m OR
- error rate +0.5% absolute for 10m
Also surface short-window spikes (5m) via Slack alert channel.

Jeff: Add enforcement on sampling and rollout scope:
- audience must be a deterministic bucketing key (user_id or org_id)
- start with cross-org sampling at 2% for 2h, then 10% for 6h, then 25% if stable
- exclude internal/test orgs via flag override
We should also add a circuit-breaker at the service layer to reject new canary requests if CPU/GPU queueing > threshold.

Jon: I'll create the alerts in ops. Proposed alerting rules:
- p95_delta > 40ms for 10m -> pager to eng-oncall + notify #eng-platform
- error_rate > 0.4% for 5m -> pager
- quality_delta <= -0.4% for 30m -> no page, but auto-rollback + incident created
I'll wire auto-rollback to the flag service via deploy-bot.

Sahil: Example flag payload I'm about to push (for ops review):

```json
{
  "flag": "new-routing-v2",
  "action": "update",
  "canary": {
    "percent": 10,
    "bucket_key": "user_id_v2",
    "exclude_segments": ["enterprise", "internal"]
  },
  "safety": {
    "auto_rollback": true,
    "rollback_triggers": ["p95_latency","quality","error_rate"]
  }
}
```

Amanda: That looks good. Add a note that rollback should include a scripted reindex/cleanup if any intermediate artifacts are created.

Maria: Also lock the experiment's evaluation window to deterministic eval sets and log every sample for offline audits.

Sahil: I'll wait for ops-bot and deploy-bot confirmations before flipping. @jon please confirm alert names and I'll run the toggle.

deploy-bot: Request received. Performing preflight checks: config valid, excluded segments present, alert hooks configured.

Jon: Alerts created: eng_platform_canary_p95_delta, eng_platform_canary_error_rate, eng_platform_canary_quality_drop. Webhooks to #eng-platform and eng-oncall set.

Sahil: Ok going to flip to 10% in 5m. I'll monitor the dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/canaries/new-routing-v2

Amanda: :thumbsup: please post quick status updates. If anything looks off, stop and rollback.

15m later

deploy-bot: Flag `new-routing-v2` set to 10% by Sahil. Rollback automation armed.

Sahil: First 10m: p95 +12ms, error rate flat, quality delta +0.02%. Looks healthy so far.

Maria: Logging looks clean. Save this as experiment: exp_2026_03_nr_v2

Jeff: Reminder: if GPU queueing > 70% we should clamp canary throughput. Ops metric: gpu_queue_util > 70 -> reduce canary to 2%.

Sahil: noted. Will keep this open for the 6h observation window and post periodic updates.
